events.title: The Hall Roof Gives Way
events.kicker: A beam cracks above the charter
events.description: Rain-softened rafters collapse across Covenant Hall. Its favorite and rank bonuses are suspended until the beam is rebuilt.

events.title: The Log Road Washes Out
events.kicker: The creek takes the lower path
events.description: A sudden washout cuts the Restorative Woodlot off from the storehouse and stops timber production.

events.title: An Archive Shelf Falls
events.kicker: Old bindings under new rubble
events.description: A restored shelf pulls free of the wall. The Living Archive closes while keepers brace it again.

events.title: Damp Reaches the Stores
events.kicker: Canvas, chalk, and a hurried inventory
events.description: A split gutter floods the Storehouse threshold. Its annex capacity is unavailable during repairs.

events.title: The Yard Crane Snaps
events.kicker: One loud crack, then silence
events.description: A lifting arm breaks in the Builder's Yard. The extra construction crew stands down until it is replaced.

events.title: The Enclave Roof Leaks
events.kicker: Five nests and one determined storm
events.description: Wind strips shingles from the Siegeling Enclave. Residents shelter elsewhere while the roof is rebuilt.

events.title: The Garden Frames Buckle
events.kicker: Green weight wins at last
events.description: Overgrown vines pull the Verdant Garden's support frames down and halt fiber work.

events.title: The Forge Flue Cracks
events.kicker: Embers where embers should not be
events.description: A cracked flue fills the Cinder Forge with smoke. The hearth must cool before repairs can hold.

events.title: The Frost Vault Thaws
events.kicker: A warm draft in a cold room
events.description: A seal gives way in the Frost Fridge. Crystal work pauses while the vault is resealed.

events.title: The Generator Arcs
events.kicker: Blue light across the courtyard
events.description: A loose contact scorches the Tempest Generator's armature and stops storm-cell production.

events.title: The Waypost Splinters
events.kicker: A cart takes the corner too sharply
events.description: The Carved Covenant Waypost is knocked from its footing and needs a careful rebuild.

events.title: The Living Trellis Tears
events.kicker: A curious Siegeling finds a loose vine
events.description: The Living Covenant Trellis comes apart in a cheerful green avalanche.

events.title: The Emberglass Lantern Shatters
events.kicker: A hot spark meets cold stone
events.description: The Emberglass Lantern breaks at its mount. Its room bonus is gone until the panes are reset.

events.title: The Frostglass Mobile Falls
events.kicker: No wind, then every chime at once
events.description: The Frostglass Memory Mobile slips its line and scatters across the vault floor.

events.title: The Harmonic Orb Goes Dark
events.kicker: The courtyard loses its hum
events.description: A surge cracks the Harmonic Current Orb's cradle and silences its production blessing.

events.title: The Stone Sentinel Topples
events.kicker: Even stone can lose its footing
events.description: Settling ground tips the Quarry Stone Sentinel into a stack of cut blocks.

events.title: The Hearth Garland Scorches
events.kicker: One pan left one moment too long
events.description: A kitchen flare singes the Harvest Hearth Garland beyond use until it is rewoven.

events.title: The Covenant Tapestry Tears
events.kicker: A draft catches the oldest seam
events.description: The Tapestry of Four Currents tears from its rail and takes its keep-wide blessing with it.

events.title: The Coppice Storewall Collapses
events.kicker: Too much timber, too little brace
events.description: The Woodlot's ventilated storewall bows outward and drops its carefully sorted harvest.

events.title: The Seedkeeper Vault Jams
events.kicker: Roots find the smallest hinge
events.description: A stubborn root locks the Seedkeeper Vault and suspends its local storage bonus.
